Home.faqNew4Q: How is the readiness score calculated?
Home.faqNew4A:
It's a 0–100 score for your license category. Sign in to see it. It shows your estimated chance of passing a real exam ticket for that category.

Only full exams count: all topics selected and the official number of questions. Exams with only some topics selected and ticket practice don't change the score, but they do count towards topic coverage.

We take your last 20 full exams (newer ones count more) and estimate how often you answer correctly, using only the questions you actually answered. From that we calculate your chance of staying within your category's mistake limit, so the same accuracy gives a lower score where fewer mistakes are allowed. If you leave an exam after a wrong answer, it still counts once its time runs out. With only a few exams the score stays cautious, so one lucky exam can't make you look ready.

You're marked ready for the real exam only when all of this is true: your score is 85 or higher, your last 3 full exams passed, and you've covered at least 65% of the topics. A topic counts as covered once you've answered about 70% of its questions, in exams or ticket practice. Until then, treat the number as a progress hint — not a guarantee you'll pass.
